trains.name: Nordsee Kuesten-Express (Coast Express)
trains.notes: Locomotive, tender, 4 coaches; steam active, coal bunker loaded, driver and fireman in cab, head and tail lamps lit

trains.name: Elbtal Personenzug (Steam Local)
trains.notes: Smaller locomotive, tender, 3 coaches; guards van; cylinder steam drifting to vault

trains.name: Vorortbahn Nord-Ost (Electric Multiple Unit A)
trains.notes: 4 cars, pantograph raised and touching catenary wire at Z=5.50 m

trains.name: Stadtbahn Hafenlinie (Electric Multiple Unit B)
trains.notes: 4 cars, doors open, passengers boarding from Platform 5, pantograph on wire at Z=5.50 m

trains.name: Reichspost & Eilgut (Parcels Train)
trains.notes: Locomotive + 7 vans, sliding door open on van 3, timber barrow on Platform 1

trains.name: Durchgangsgueterzug (Goods Through Train)
trains.notes: Locomotive + 6 wagons on track 12 through road, crew visible in cab and brake van
